title: Independent Living Service Charge List — Replacements, Lockouts, Move-Out Cleaning and Transfers
content:
The following service charges apply under the Independent Living Residency Agreement. Amounts are in US dollars.

## Charges that are the same for every apartment type

| Service | Charge |
|---|---|
| Replacement of a lost or damaged apartment key fob | 25.00 per fob |
| Replacement of a lost or damaged emergency response pendant | 145.00 per pendant |
| After-hours lockout service call beyond the included calls | 35.00 per call |
| After-hours lockout calls included at no charge in a rolling 12-month window | 2 |

## Charges that differ by apartment type

| Apartment type | Standard move-out carpet and floor cleaning fee (charged when the apartment is vacated) | Administrative and turnover fee for a resident-requested transfer to another independent living apartment |
|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Studio | 165.00 | 750.00 |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom | 185.00 | 750.00 |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom Deluxe | 205.00 | 950.00 |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom | 235.00 | 950.00 |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom Deluxe | 260.00 | 1,150.00 |
| Independent Living Cottage Home | 310.00 | 1,450.00 |

Transfer fees written plainly: 750.00, 750.00, 950.00, 950.00, 1150.00 and 1450.00.

## Notes

- The move-out carpet and floor cleaning fee listed is the standard fee of the apartment type.
- The transfer fee is a fee per transfer.

Hypothetical example: a resident who loses both a key fob and an emergency response pendant is charged 25.00 and 145.00, a total of 170.00.
